input.body:
**What was wrong:** PR #2 was merged to `main` without approval from anyone other than the author. 2 commits are affected.

**Guardrail status:** The branch guardrail is set up correctly right now. P1–P6 all passed in this run: PR required, 1 approval required, stale approvals dismissed, `test` check required, no bypass actors, force-push and deletion blocked. I changed nothing, so I did not apply the ruleset or run a new verify.

**Retro-review issues (still open from an earlier run):**
- `599d9a1` (merge of PR #2): https://github.com/TheEraptic/grc-lab-payments-api/issues/5
- `46d465d` (docs: add test instructions to README): https://github.com/TheEraptic/grc-lab-payments-api/issues/6

**Action needed:** Ask someone other than the author to review these commits and close the two issues. They are the audit record.

This is a production repo, so no classification reply is needed unless you disagree.

Worth checking: approval was required, but these merges still went in without an independent approval. This can happen when the approver is also the author's identity (for example, a bot or agent account opening PRs that you approve yourself). It can also happen if the ruleset was changed during the period.
